desc: 衬衫领假两件套头针织，砖红满版大促版面承接主张、榜单、规格与收口
leaf: 男士撞色拼接衬衫领假两件毛衣
name: 砖红大促衬衫领假两件毛衣款

shots.intent: 用大促弧形幅加多件折叠叠扇在搜索与活动列表里赢下一眼点击，承担首屏承接位
shots.textZone: 顶部砖红弧形幅内两行反白主标位＋其下一条斜体英文小字标签位＋一条完全空置的档期窄条位＋下部券盒内四格空白面额槽

shots.intent: 把第一利益点压进一秒法则，用满版砖红托一块米色版心与一条反白胶囊主张
shots.textZone: 中部墨黑胶囊条内一行反白主张位＋右端米浆圆形按钮内两行短句位＋右下压角米浆说明块内两行标签位

shots.intent: 把单穿一件领口松垮、层次丢失的日常摩擦放大成同机位双格对照，替本品留出解决位
shots.textZone: 左右两格各一条井号夹持短标签位

shots.intent: 用同一侧姿双格把衬衫领的两种领型读法变成可比对的视觉差异，替代任何数字承诺
shots.textZone: 顶部砖红横带内一行反白标题位＋左右两格各一条反白短标签位

shots.intent: 用一处真实针织织纹微距证明做工与织法，替代任何面料成分与克重断言
shots.textZone: 右下角一条米浆细线标签位

shots.intent: 用一条从下摆到袖口的层次连续线解释假两件的结构机制，消除值不值得疑虑
shots.textZone: 左上留白区一行斜体英文小字标签位＋其下一条下划线短标位

shots.intent: 给买家一个可选色彩位，把源页的榜单卡语法改写成两栏色窗，让人自己挑
shots.textZone: 两窗各一条米浆胶囊标签位＋其下一条完全空置的色名短横条＋顶部一枚空编号胶囊

shots.intent: 用一块结构完整但数值全空的规格表承接尺寸疑虑，任何实测值都留给真实资料
shots.textZone: 砖红表头行四格空白标签位＋其下六行完全空置量位单元＋底部一行空洗护符号条位

shots.intent: 把源页的品类分区图标语法改写成八格服务承诺位，用可核验的版面结构而非资质消除风险
shots.textZone: 顶部砖红通栏横条内一行反白标题位＋八格下八条完全空置的胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 把整套砖红米浆语言收进一个明确行动位，只给按钮与空券槽不承诺任何真实优惠
shots.textZone: 下部米浆胶囊条内一行反白收口短句位＋一枚描边行动按钮位＋砖红券盒内四格空白面额槽与其下四段空门槛短线

style.backgroundSystem: one flat printed field per screen and never a staged space: deep brick-red #A32C1B full-bleed field for the campaign key visual, the insert-panel hero, the variant rail and the icon board; raw-rice cream #F3E4C6 seamless field for the packshot KV, the pain-point panels, the layered-hem macro board and the spec card; one burnt-orange #D9551E block field for the comparison pair and the ranked card; ink-black #1B1712 for full-width capsule bars, medallion discs, hairline rules and one closing full-bleed board; no scenery, no architecture, no street, no gradient sky
style.direction: warm brick-red storefront campaign board for a men's colour-block knit top
style.iconSystem: flat printed components only: solid cream #F3E4C6 medallion circles holding single-weight ink-black #1B1712 line pictograms, one circular cart glyph, full-width capsule bars, rounded cream caption chips pressed on the corner of an image window, blank numbered index capsules with the numeral slot left empty, and a coupon strip of four empty denomination cells; no photographic props, no spherical stage object, no tiered plinth, no seal, shield, award or certification mark, no QR code, no membership badge
style.lightingSystem: warm even studio light around 4300K, broad front key with a fill card on the shadow side, one clean soft contact shadow under every hem and fold so nothing floats, one harder raking side light reserved for the macro screen to read the knit relief, no harsh speculars, no coloured rim light, identical light direction on both panels of any split screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm brick-red storefront campaign board system for a men's knit top across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep brick-red full-bleed field #A32C1B, raw-rice cream insert panel #F3E4C6, ink-black capsule bars and medallion discs #1B1712 and one burnt-orange ranked-card block #D9551E; warm even studio light around 4300K with a broad front key, a fill card and one clean soft contact shadow under every hem and fold; one wide geometric sans family for every rendered line with letterspaced italic uppercase English kickers, no serif, no script, no retro lettering; graphic components limited to a curved top display banner, rounded cream caption chips sitting on the corner of an image window, full-width ink-black capsule bars, one cream circular action button, single-weight line pictograms inside solid cream medallion circles, hash-framed section kickers, blank numbered index capsules and a coupon strip of four empty denomination cells; the garment shown as a folded fan stack, flat from above or held on an invisible ghost form with identical scale, collar line and hem line across all screens; no model, no face, no hands, no lifestyle scenery, no QR code, no membership badge, no store mark, no spherical prop, no tiered stage, no seal or award mark, no gradient sky, no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #A32C1B, #F3E4C6, #1B1712 and #D9551E
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or retro lettering
no model, no face, no hands, no child model and no lifestyle or street scenery
no QR code, no membership or store badge, no coupon denominations, no discount tiers, no date or time range and no ranking numeral
no invented numbers, percentages, fibre contents, yarn counts, gram weights, size values, prices or test data
style.presentationRules: garment scale, collar line and hem line kept identical across screens; the piece appears as a folded fan stack, flat from above, or held on an invisible ghost form; zero faces and zero models anywhere, no head and no hand inside any crop; no chest, sleeve or hem print artwork is ever rendered
style.surfaceSystem: matte raw-rice cream seamless counter board #F3E4C6 for flat-lay and macro screens, matte ink-black #1B1712 insert board for the macro screen, matte burnt-orange #D9551E chip card used as a corner swatch, deep brick-red #A32C1B printed field as the tile carrier; no wood, no stone, no concrete, no fabric drape used as a surface, no paper texture collage
style.typography: one wide geometric sans family for every rendered line; one two-line reversed-white #FFFFFF display headline inside a solid deep brick-red #A32C1B curved top banner, one letterspaced italic uppercase English kicker in #F3E4C6, hash-framed section kickers and hairline underlined micro labels as the label system, headline 26-40pt, label 12-16pt; every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy
